operations.why: r/26_u3 leaves NetworkItemStackDescriptor as a title-only local definition; restore the published six-field cerealizer shape so inventory packets do not silently become unit types. r/26_u3 leaves MolangVariableMap as a title-only local definition; the established packet wire shape is a length-prefixed JSON string. See https://github.com/TwistedAsylumMC/bpd-fixer/blob/824b89b8602008ea99401b507059fc2f45e08a40/output/json/MolangVariableMap.json.
Route r/26_u3's title-only NetworkItemStackDescriptor references to the documented in-memory compatibility schema above.
Route r/26_u3's title-only MolangVariableMap reference to the documented in-memory string schema above.
